theme: oncall handoff ROTATE FLATTEN COUNTMATCH CHUNK soft primary

tests.name: seed_peek_handoff
tests.cmd: seed alice..dave; peek alice; handoff → bob primary; handback → alice

tests.name: open_tally
tests.cmd: open 5 incidents; list/tally ERROR WARN page

tests.name: pin_drop
tests.cmd: pin carol primary; drop dave; drop ghost REQUIRE

tests.name: countmatch_substring
tests.cmd: COUNTMATCH error hits terror (error inside terror)

weaknesses.title: COUNTMATCH substring: needle error matches terror
weaknesses.detail: COUNTMATCH 'error' on 'terror alert' counts 1 because terror contains error. Severity tallies overcount false friends. No word-boundary / token COUNTMATCH.

weaknesses.title: CHUNK+FLATTEN space-join destroys multi-word names
weaknesses.detail: Engineer 'ann lee' after CHUNK 2 + FLATTEN becomes ann and lee. Same class as deploy wave host spaces. No structured nested bags.

weaknesses.title: ROTATE RIGHT/LEFT keywords steal identifier space
weaknesses.detail: Same class as STRIDE OFF. Vars named RIGHT/LEFT risky near ROTATE forms. SYS ROTATE RIGHT K stack works when K is numeric var.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT RIGHT=1 near SYS ROTATE RIGHT …

weaknesses.title: COUNTMATCH returns count only — easy to confuse with GREP filter
weaknesses.detail: LAST_N is count; bag not filtered. Agents expecting filtered lines must still GREP. Useful but surprising vs GREPCOUNT name.
weaknesses.repro: COUNTMATCH logs ERROR; LAST is not the ERROR lines

weaknesses.title: ROTATE/CHUNK/FLATTEN non-mutate
weaknesses.detail: Must LET stack = LAST after handoff/reclaim or WRITE stale order.
weaknesses.repro: ROTATE 1 stack; WRITE path stack still old without LET

weaknesses.title: No exact-token severity tally form
weaknesses.detail: COUNTLINE is exact whole field; COUNTMATCH is substring. Missing middle: count fields whose first token is ERROR.
weaknesses.repro: need CUTALL 0 then COUNTLINE or FREQ for true severity tokens

weaknesses.title: COUNTMATCHI still substring-unsafe
weaknesses.detail: Case-insensitive error still matches terror and ERROR. I flag only helps case, not boundaries.

workarounds: Tally with CUTALL first-token then FREQ/COUNTLINE not raw COUNTMATCH on free text
Ban spaces in oncall names before CHUNK/FLATTEN
Use HASLINE for engineer identity not FIRSTMATCH
language_gaps: Nested bag CHUNK without join flatten
COUNTMATCH mode that returns matching fields (or clearer docs vs GREP)
issues_faced: Confirmed terror contains error — COUNTMATCH false friend high for ops tallies
FLATTEN space-name corruption expected but severe for real person names
ROTATE handoff/handback round-trip works cleanly with LET rebind
No language fix this fire — token COUNTMATCH for MEANINGFUL_ITER
